package main

import (
    "bufio"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    regexp "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/ecmascript/regexp"
)
func main() {
    data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]); if err != nil { panic(err) }
    var cases []string
    if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil { panic(err) }
    output := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
    for _, source := range cases {
        for flags := 0; flags < 16; flags++ {
            next, width, matched := regexp.AdamicModifierGroup(source, flags)
            yes := 0; if matched { yes = 1 }
            fmt.Fprintf(output, "%d,%d,%d\n", next, width, yes)
        }
    }
    if err = output.Flush(); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
